name: ai-tab-grouper
description: Chrome MV3 extension that groups tabs by topic using Claude, Gemini Nano or a domain heuristic.

scripts.test:coverage: c8 --check-coverage --lines 85 --branches 75 --functions 85 --include "src/lib/**" --include src/background.js --include "bridge/src/**" --include bridge/install.mjs --reporter text --reporter lcov node --test "test/**/*.test.js" "bridge/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.package: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --filename ai-tab-grouper-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest --ignore-files CLAUDE.md .claude ".claude/**" .gitignore bridge "bridge/**" test "test/**" docs "docs/**" scripts "scripts/**" coverage "coverage/**" .github ".github/**" dist "*.md" "package*.json" "eslint.config.js" Makefile
scripts.prepublish:cws: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:deps && npm run package && npm run cws:check
